body_long:
Christian Zandonella is the general manager of the Danieli, A Four Seasons Hotel, Venice, one of the most famous hotel names in Italy.

## Two decades, many cities

Born in South Tyrol and raised in Munich, he started with an apprenticeship in food and beverage in Munich. Then came two decades in sales and marketing, food and beverage and general management, in Vienna, Bahrain, Toronto, Berlin, Capri, Barcelona and Rome.

The Danieli brought him back to Italy. Four Seasons announced his appointment in December 2025, to lead the hotel's new chapter within the group.

## A landmark on the lagoon

The Danieli stands on the Riva degli Schiavoni, a few steps from Piazza San Marco. It is made of three interconnected palaces, including the 15th-century Palazzo Dandolo.

The hotel has been redesigned by Pierre-Yves Rochon. Four Seasons planned the relaunch for mid-2026, with the number of rooms and suites growing to 176 by 2027.

## The signal

When a global brand takes over a historic house, the choice of general manager says a lot. Four Seasons chose a hotelier with Italian roots and a career built across very different markets.

For hoteliers, it is a reminder that the most sought-after leaders combine two things: the culture of the place and the standards of an international group. That mix is what lets a legendary address change brand without losing its soul.

We wish Christian Zandonella and the Danieli teams every success.
